content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My tarot deck keeps giving me The Star. It means I have a destiny.
I can’t evaluate destiny. How often does The Star appear relative to total draws, and how are you shuffling?
I shuffle by hand and draw one card nightly. It showed up 4 times this week.
Out of seven nights, that’s 4/7. Recording 30 nights with the same method would show whether the frequency stays high or trends toward typical proportions.
If all cards are equally likely, each major arcana appears infrequently across many draws. A running tally makes deviations visible without interpretation.
Yes, and keeping the shuffle technique constant helps isolate the variable of interest—the card frequency.
